title: EnableAmendment
key_points: EnableAmendment is a transaction type in XRP Ledger.
It allows an account to enable or disable amendments for itself or another account.
The EnableAmendment transaction uses the amendment_hash parameter to specify which amendment to enable or disable.
Enabling or disabling an amendment does not require a majority consensus, making it a fast and efficient process.
limitations: The source focuses on technical details of the EnableAmendment transaction type in the XRP Ledger protocol.
It does not discuss potential limitations or drawbacks of using this transaction type.
asserts: Enabling or disabling amendments for an account can be done quickly using the EnableAmendment transaction without requiring consensus.
